correctness.rationale: The exact 68-facet Lutz 11-vertex four-manifold has f-vector (11,55,150,170,68). Reimplemented the actual frozen facet-set enumeration and independent GF(2) boundary elimination, obtaining ranks of d2 (triangles→edges) 45 and d3 (tetrahedra→triangles) 103, hence dim H2=150-45-103=2. Of all C(11,4)=330 four-sets, exactly 228 have four triangular faces, including 170 existing tetrahedra; the other 58 are missing tetrahedra. For every one the four-triangle boundary is a closed mod-two 2-cycle outside image d3. Their pairwise differences mod boundary classify the 58 into exactly three nonzero H2 classes of sizes 6,24,28. Any nonzero mod-two simplicial 2-cycle supported on <=3 vertices is impossible, and on exactly 4 vertices the only nonzero 2-cycle is the whole tetrahedral boundary. Therefore these are ALL minimum-vertex-support nonzero 2-cycle carriers in THIS complex. Exhaustive finite exact check proves this fixed-object claim, not a universal family theorem.
